subject.title: [Bug]: Native Talk button triggers OpenAI Realtime WebRTC call and fails with 500 when Realtime is not configured

question: Should Control UI browser Talk start from implicit OpenAI/Codex realtime credential availability, or only after an explicit talk.realtime readiness/preflight says the selected provider is usable?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally allow API-key/OAuth/Codex fallback, while this report expects a local/non-Realtime Talk setup not to start OpenAI Realtime; either choice changes setup semantics and compatibility.

options.title: Gate On Gateway Readiness
options.body: Disable or block browser Talk before microphone startup unless Gateway readiness reports a usable realtime provider, while preserving the chosen credential policy.

options.title: Keep Implicit Credential Activation
options.body: Treat configured OpenAI/Codex realtime auth as enough to start Talk and limit follow-up work to clearer diagnostics for provider/API failures.

options.title: Require Explicit Realtime Config
options.body: Only show or start browser Talk when talk.realtime is explicitly configured, accepting any migration or upgrade impact for existing users.

recommendation.title: Gate On Gateway Readiness
recommendation.body: Disable or block browser Talk before microphone startup unless Gateway readiness reports a usable realtime provider, while preserving the chosen credential policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the most recent merged auth-policy change and documentation that define the current OpenAI Realtime fallback behavior.
